messages:
nina_sales: Need a hosted API key for Meridian POC. Requirements: 12-day TTL, rotate day 6, IP allowlist 192.0.2.0/24, request logging with prompt redaction. Demo in 48h. How fast can we spin this up?

omar_se: We can do workspace-scoped or ephemeral. Ephemeral preferred by customer but risk of mid-demo rotation. Recommend ephemeral with scheduled pre-demo renew at T-3h.

nina_sales: Yes pre-demo renew please. Also ask ops to webhook revoke notifications to #sales and to my inbox.

leo_security: Security note: redact PII, retention 90 days ok for POC. Need an approval ticket reference.

harper_ops: Approval ticket MER-POC-987 exists. Creating key now. Internal CLI used: `redwoodctl keys create --workspace meridian-poc --owner nina_sales --ttl 12d --rotate-after 6d --pre-demo-renew 3h --allowlist 192.0.2.0/24 --redact-logs true --audit-retention 90d --notify-webhook https://hooks.redwood.sales/meridian/revoke`

opsbot: Key created: key_MER123abc (expires 2026-04-16T11:00:00Z). Rotation scheduled in 6 days. Pre-demo renewal set. Audit logging enabled, redaction: true.

omar_se: I'll DM the key to nina via secure channel. Reminder: do NOT paste key into customer chat.

nina_sales: Got it, thanks. Can we add a one-liner revoke playbook I can send to the customer?

leo_security: Revoke playbook: 1) Ops revoke via portal/CLI -> immediate invalidation. 2) System posts to #sales + webhook. 3) Ops confirm audit entry + close approval ticket. 4) Reissue requires fresh approval.

harper_ops: Added automation: if approval ticket state becomes "blocked" the system revokes key automatically and notifies #sales.

nina_sales: Perfect. Sharing with Meridian now. Will confirm after smoke test. :thumbsup:
